channel.title: Alex Gerard — Writing
channel.description: Notes on development, tooling, and the craft of building software.

item.title: A Bash Script for My Battery Status
item.description: Discover how to configure a simple bash script to monitor battery level on Arch Linux, with custom notifications and detailed logs. Why use complex tools when you can configure everything yourself, lightly and efficiently? Staying true to the Arch spirit: total control and simplicity.

item.title: Twitch Stream End Credits: Madyann Project
item.description: In the streaming world, recognizing community contributions is essential. We designed a custom end scene for Madyann

item.title: Automated PDF Generation and Deployment on a VPS
item.description: Automating PDF generation from Org Mode and LaTeX files, followed by their deployment on a VPS server, can be achieved in a few key steps. This includes compiling source files, merging PDFs, and uploading to the remote server via specific commands.

item.title: Why and How I Use Emacs for Writing Course Notes
item.description: Emacs is an extensible and customizable tool that I use to efficiently organize my course notes. With the built-in Org-mode module, I can structure my ideas, manage complex documents, and produce PDF files without difficulty.
